hero.title: Supporting less privileged girls, mothers and children.
hero.text: Action for Progress is a charitable organization working through advocacy, donation and sensitization, with a focus on girl child education and the child and maternal death rate.

intro.title: A local organization with two clear focus areas.
intro.text: We support less privileged girls, mothers and children in our community. Our work is delivered through advocacy, donation and sensitization.

items.title: Advocacy
items.text: Speaking up for the needs of less privileged girls, mothers and children.

items.title: Donation
items.text: Working with supporters to provide practical help to the people we serve.

items.title: Sensitization
items.text: Raising awareness in the community on the issues that affect girls, mothers and children.
